requirements.description: Production Supabase (ehfafcnimmjusyvplbah) and staging are strictly air-gapped; no SQL migrations or checkpoints executed; verifier is strictly offline.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Local filesystem artifacts only; zero network/database imports
requirements.expectedResult: Verifier runs entirely offline with zero network calls and strict local repo path confinement
requirements.remainingLimitations: Requires authoritative local JSON files for authoritative verification mode

requirements.description: Independently validate that each proposed correction matches canonical manifest record ID and target candidate UUID in crosswalk and ledger.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Correction ID, manifest record ID, crosswalk target candidateUuid, ledger target candidateUuid
requirements.expectedResult: Rejects any correction where ID is not in manifest or target UUID disagrees
requirements.remainingLimitations: Crosswalk and ledger must be indexed

requirements.description: Declared original represented value in correction entry must exactly equal the manifest field value.

requirements.section: Section 2: Mandatory Source Coordinates & Coordinate Resolution
requirements.description: Every correction must provide sourceFile and sourceLocation, and source coordinates must resolve to the exact target record matching candidateName and acNo.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: sourceFile, sourceLocation (1-based line number), candidateName, acNo
requirements.expectedResult: Rejects missing coordinates with MISSING_SOURCE_COORDINATE or mismatch with SOURCE_COORDINATE_MISMATCH
requirements.remainingLimitations: Source files must exist within approved repo path

requirements.section: Section 2: Positive Asset & Liability Source Total Equivalence
requirements.description: Positive asset and liability restorations must match independently verified source profile value, ledger source total, and intended restored total.
requirements.expectedResult: Rejects any discrepancy with SOURCE_RESTORED_VALUE_MISMATCH or SOURCE_VALUE_UNAVAILABLE

requirements.description: Genuine zero in source filing must never be coerced to NULL. Missing disclosure requires affirmative evidence and cannot mutate positive totals.

requirements.section: Section 3: Canonical Realpath & Path Boundary Containment
requirements.description: Ensure target source files strictly reside within repository root using realpath canonicalization; reject drive-hopping, UNC paths, and traversal.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Target source path, repository root directory
requirements.expectedResult: Throws PATH_OUTSIDE_REPO_ROOT on any escape, UNC prefix, or directory traversal attempt

requirements.section: Section 3: Lexical AST Scanner & Comment/String/Nesting Containment
requirements.description: Lexical AST scanner isolates target object literal boundaries, strips comments, respects escaped quotes/backslashes, and ignores nested object properties.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Source profile file text, line coordinate
requirements.expectedResult: Correctly parses top-level properties; excludes comments, escaped string traps, and nested sub-objects

requirements.section: Section 3: Mandatory Identity Properties in Source Profile
requirements.description: Source profile object parsing must require candidateName and acNo to be present; failure triggers fail-closed error.
requirements.expectedResult: Throws MISSING_REQUIRED_IDENTITY_FIELD when candidateName or acNo is missing

requirements.section: Section 4: Application Nullable Financial Types & Utilities
requirements.description: affidavitTypes.ts & legislatorProfileTypes.ts declare financial fields as number | null. formatINR returns 'Not Disclosed' for null/undefined. computeWealthGrowth handles nulls with isAvailable: false.
requirements.negativeTestCase: Jest sprint14-16.test.ts (detectRedFlags zero liability null check)
requirements.expectedResult: formatINR(null) returns 'Not Disclosed'; computeWealthGrowth with null returns isAvailable: false; red flags avoid false positives
requirements.actualResult: EXECUTED AND PASSED (34/34 Jest tests passed, 0 tsc errors)

requirements.section: Section 4: Mobile Consumer UI Component Hardening
requirements.description: FinancialBreakdownCard, AffidavitCard, WealthTimeline, LegislatorDetailScreen, and AffidavitsStore hardened against nulls with zero || 0 fallbacks and accurate aggregate denominators.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Null assets/liabilities in components and store aggregations
requirements.expectedResult: Zero type errors, zero runtime TypeErrors on null financial values, undisclosed candidates excluded from average asset denominator

requirements.section: Section 5: Verifier Test Suite Expansion to 50 Tests
requirements.description: Expanded verifier test suite to 50 comprehensive tests covering all mutation scenarios, AST isolation, nullable contracts, and exit codes.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Synthetic fixtures and direct unit test cases
requirements.expectedResult: 50/50 tests execute and pass offline with captured machine-readable results

requirements.description: Reconcile affidavit count (4524 - 1 phantom = 4523 canonical). Document demographic count (4142 -> 4123) as partially verified due to lack of an isolated 19-record exclusion ledger.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Affidavit manifest (4523), phantom affidavit ID (0215b22e-aff-00001571), demographics inventory (4142)
requirements.expectedResult: Accurate forensic accounting of population lineage; explicit identification of partially verified demographic ledger
requirements.remainingLimitations: Authoritative seed reconciliation ledger for 19 demographic records must be provided in future directive

requirements.description: Generate comprehensive SHA-256 manifest covering all deliverables, test outputs, and matrices.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Committed and delivered source files, test fixtures, and report artifacts
requirements.expectedResult: Bitwise reproducible SHA-256 manifest of all deliverables
